title: Help Desk Integrations
snippet:
LiveAgent’s support system software offers three subscriptions. All of them provide many features, and some of them are for additional fees. However, **API and integrations are included in each subscription without any additional costs**.
- **Small subscription** – $15 per agent
- **Medium subscription** – $29 per agent
- **Large subscription** – $49 per agent
LiveAgent provides a 30-day free trial for each subscription. If you are still unsure after that time, we also provide a free account with limitations.
If you would like to learn about additional features included in each subscription, read Pricing.

### API
**API (Application Programming Interface)** integration helps two applications to ‘communicate" between each other. This way you can connect your tools, programs, and more! With LiveAgent’s API, you can automate workflows, retrieve data, and create custom integrations tailored to your business needs.
If you would like to learn about more possible API actions, read LiveAgent – API.

LiveAgent
Streamline customer support with LiveAgent's all-in-one service desk software. Try a 30-day free trial—no credit card needed!

title: Documentation
snippet:
You can find whole LiveAgent API documentation within your LiveAgent account:
*https://**YOURDOMAIN.**ladesk.com/docs/api/v3/#/*
You can also navigate into your *agent panel > Configuration > System > API > API V3 DOCUMENTATION*

Within the documentation, you can find examples and use the possibility to test the API commands with your account.
1. Consider registering a new [free Trial account](https://www.liveagent.com/trial/) for testing purposes, before using API with your live account.
2. Generate API key for APIv3: [https://support.liveagent.com/741982-API-key](https://support.liveagent.com/741982-API-key)
3. Authorize the LiveAgent API on https://**YOURDOMAIN.**ladesk.com/docs/api/v3/#/ and add scopes you need for the API to work:
![](https://support.liveagent.com/public/article/12773/attachment/k912nbjf1k8z7ejg7nho8pa3m9dpbeen/view)
4. Choose the object (agents, tickets, .) & method (get, post, delete) and press the "Try it out" button
![](https://support.liveagent.com/public/article/12773/attachment/3hl5gjt6bzz426xqg7jh9lucmu9nkdao/view)
5. Fill the required parameters, press the "execute" button & see the results
![](https://support.liveagent.com/public/article/12773/attachment/isxt5mu5b6wua24d2kl0si6br404bp90/view)
There are limits related to API and API keys. [Here](https://support.liveagent.com/931802-API-rate-limit-API-requests-limit) you can find more info.
